entries.name: Capacity Planning
entries.body: Quarterly capacity reviews aligned with provider capability declarations and projected query growth.

entries.name: Documentation Standard
entries.body: All modules, doctrines, and invariants must have human-readable documentation and machine-readable schemas.

entries.name: Naming Convention
entries.body: Sovereign deployments follow {Cultural}Seek pattern: DragonSeek (CN), GangaSeek (IN), JinnSeek (GCC), EagleSeek (US).

entries.name: Version Lineage
entries.body: Every version must declare its lineage: predecessor version, change summary, and ratification record.

entries.name: Interoperability Testing
entries.body: Cross-provider interoperability tests run weekly. Failures block affected routing paths.

entries.name: Security Baseline
entries.body: All components meet NIST CSF baseline. Sovereign zones may impose additional requirements.
